claims.statement: RSVP second-target detection was impaired in a short post-target interval and conditional controls altered it
Lag-1 sparing and temporal-order errors complicate the fixed bottleneck story
Consecutive target groups without distractors may escape a simplistic fixed-capacity blink model
2007 longitudinal groups comprised 17 retreat practitioners and 23 novice comparisons
Retreat group practiced about ten to twelve hours each day for three months, not twelve minutes
Second-target report improved more in retreat participants with first-target P3b attenuation
Non-equivalent group exposure and self-selection limit causal and consumer generalization
Seller advertises Zen12 Premium twelve levels, forty-eight MP3s and twelve-minute sessions
Seller claims twelve-minute sessions have benefits of an hour of meditation
Seller advertises a one-year refund guarantee but fulfillment and full checkout terms remain untested
2023 fourteen-study EEG review has five supportive, eight contrary and one mixed findings
2007 intensive retreat findings and general EEG review cannot establish Zen12's named-product effectiveness
Inspire3 public portal exists and markets commissions but provides no named Final Vestige acceptance
No private publisher dashboard or permitted channel terms authenticated in this run
Clear conspicuous material connection disclosures needed adjacent to endorsements and recommendation links
Objective mental or health outcome claims need competent, reliable and context-appropriate substantiation
Final Vestige's Focus page currently describes one existing fifty-two page Fieldbook and Dispatch opt-in
Focus Shot seller says audio leads to multiple hours of intense concentration; no product-specific validation inspected
Total Focus seller advertises productivity and concentration outcomes; no product-specific validation inspected
